acquisition_method.evidence: Mass spectrometer was operated in data-dependent acquisition mode.

alkylation_concentration.evidence: Equal amounts of protein (20 mg) were mixed and the cysteine residues were reduced and alkylated with 5 mM DTT for 20 min at 60 °C and 10 mM iodoacetamide for 10 min at room temperature respectively.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: Equal amounts of protein (20 mg) were mixed and the cysteine residues were reduced and alkylated with 5 mM DTT for 20 min at 60 °C and 10 mM iodoacetamide for 10 min at room temperature respectively.

cleavage_agent.evidence: For trypsin digestion, the samples were diluted such that urea was <2 M with 20 mM HEPES, pH 8.0 and subjected to digestion with TPCK treated trypsin (Worthington Biochemical Corp, Lakewood, NJ) for 12–16 h at room temperature.

collision_energy.evidence: Most intense fifteen precursor ions with charge state ≥2 were isolated and fragmented using HCD fragmentation with 30 % normalized collision energy and detected at a mass resolution of 30,000 at 400 m/z.

ionization_type.evidence: inferred: The enriched phosphotyrosine containing peptides were analyzed on Orbitrap Fusion Tribrid mass spectrometer (Thermo Electron, Bremen, Germany) interfaced with Easy-nLC II nanoflow liquid chromatography system (Thermo Scientific, Odense, Denmark).

mass_analyzer.evidence: inferred: Using high resolution Orbitrap Fusion™ Tribrid™ Fourier transform mass spectrometer, we identified 627 phosphotyrosine sites mapping to 357 proteins.
